sentences.text: Ann Biderman -LRB- born August 15 , 1951 -RRB- is an American film and television writer .

She is the creator and executive producer of the NBC/TNT series Southland -LRB- 2009 -- 2013 -RRB- , and won an Emmy Award for Outstanding Individual Achievement in Writing in a Drama Series for an episode of NYPD Blue .	Southland	Southland (TV series)	NYPD Blue	NYPD Blue
